NORTHSTAR DESIGN • PROPOSAL 027 / 1

Customer onboarding redesign

Proposal for Alder Studio

Prepared for Alder Studio • Prepared by Northstar Design Issued 18 June 2027 • Proposal valid through 2 July 2027

THE OUTCOME

A clearer first-week experience: one welcome journey, one account checklist and fewer handoffs between sales and customer success.

What we heard

New customers receive setup instructions in three separate emails. The proposed work consolidates those steps, clarifies ownership and gives the service team a reusable launch checklist.

Scope and delivery

PhaseDeliverablesSchedule
DiscoverFive staff interviews; journey map; agreed problem statementWeek 1
DesignWelcome flow; six screen designs; email copy outlineWeeks 2–3
HandoverAnnotated prototype; component notes; two training sessionsWeek 4

How we will work

  • One 30-minute review each Tuesday, with a named client decision-maker.
  • Two consolidated feedback rounds on the prototype.
  • Shared decision log and weekly written delivery update.

Outside this scope

Production code, system migration, translation and new brand identity work are excluded. Any added scope requires a written change agreement.

Investment and approval

Payment schedule

40% at kickoff ($4,800), 40% at prototype review ($4,800), and 20% at handover ($2,400). This illustrative price excludes applicable taxes and third-party expenses.

Client responsibilities

  • Provide current onboarding material and access to five interview participants.
  • Return consolidated feedback within two working days.
  • Confirm content accuracy and nominate an approver before kickoff.

Acceptance criteria

Handover is complete when the agreed six screens, email outline, annotated prototype and training sessions have been delivered. The project lead records acceptance or a specific list of scope-related corrections.

Proposed next step

Confirm the scope and proposed 5 July kickoff. The parties should finalize their service agreement before work begins.
